title: 2025 Topps Series 1 Baseball TYLER PHILLIPS Base RC #293 Philadelphia Phillies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2025 Topps Series 1 Baseball trading card featuring Tyler Phillips of the Philadelphia Phillies. This card is a part of the base set and marked as a rookie card, making it a desirable collectible for fans and collectors. As a product from Topps, it is expected to be a quality item with a focus on highlighting the player and team in the Major League Baseball (MLB) season of 2025. The card number is specified as 293, adding to its uniqueness within the set.
